hmfAppliesTo: Commercial cargo loaded or unloaded at US ports by vessel (not air, truck or rail).

sources.mpfCitation: 91 FR 48398 (July 31, 2026), Table 2 on p. 48399: 19 CFR 24.23(b)(1)(i)(B) minimum $34.58 / maximum $670.86; ad valorem rate 0.3464% unchanged (82 FR 50523). Required as of October 1, 2026.
sources.hmfCitation: 19 CFR 24.24: harbor maintenance fee of 0.125 percent of the value of commercial cargo (not inflation-adjusted).

note: FY2027 values (Oct 1 2026 - Sep 30 2027) verified against the Federal Register notice 2026-15530. MPF applies to formal entries (0.3464% of entered value, clamped to min/max per entry); HMF only to vessel shipments. Re-verify each August when CBP publishes the next fiscal year's adjustment.
